in_latin.name: Gregorios
in_latin.meaning: Name of a bishop and saint in the early Christian church
in_latin.long_meaning: Gregorios is the Latinized form of the Greek name Γρηγόριος, derived from the Greek words 'gregor' meaning 'watchful' or 'alert' and 'oros' meaning 'dawn'. It is associated with Saint Gregory the Illuminator, the patron saint of Armenia, who led the country to Christianity in the 3rd century AD. In the early Christian church, the name Gregorios was given to bishops and clergy who were known for their watchfulness over the church and their efforts to spread the Gospel to new regions.
